test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word from the following sentence.**

Magical

The stories of the Arabian Nights are enchanting, interesting, vivacious, and natural.
solution: The correct answer is **"enchanting."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Magical"** means that seems to use magic. (जादू का सा असर छोड़ने वाला; जादुई) • **Example**: *She has **magical**__ powers.* • **"Enchanting"** means having a magical or captivating quality. (जादुई या मनोरम गुण होना) __ • **Example**: *The ballet performance was **enchanting**__, with its beautiful music and graceful dancers.* • It is a synonym of the given word** 'magical'.** • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Interesting** means engaging or holding one's attention. (आनंदप्रद और मनोरंजक; ध्‍यान को बाँधकर रखने वाला, रोचक) • **Natural** means existing in or derived from nature; not made or caused by humankind. (प्रकृति में विद्यमान, प्राकृतिक, मानव-प्रेरित या निर्मित नहीं; नैसर्गिक) • **Vivacious** means lively and animated. ((व्‍यक्ति, प्रायः महिला) स्‍वस्‍थ, ज़िंदादिल और ख़ुशमिज़ाज) 3d:Tc07, The correct answer is **"Abnormality."**
